Team,

For the upcoming planning window, we need to decide how to allocate capacity across eight product programs at Ridgefield Works with the objective of maximizing total contribution. Below is the business context and the specific levers we can pull, along with how each program draws on our constrained resources.

Aurora Alloy Batch A
